declaration.argument: Only how the compiled interpreter passes values changes: an operand whose local slot is dead after its operation, by a decode-time liveness pass over each function, and not read by a later position of the same operation, is moved out of its slot instead of cloned, and a local copied onto itself is skipped. Both apply only under NoHashing; eager signatures keep the clone and the write. Label paths and every function whose vertices or slots are not its own decode without moves. A value that is moved is never read again before its slot is written, checked by an independent read-after-move checker over the 26 compiling specs with a mutation test. No draw, value, row, container order or anything the search reads changes. One-thread identity against the baseline binary on VR (3,008 runs), Mencius (2,160 runs) and a caps-engaged VR session of 100,000 runs: every table identical both ways, same stall_cap_runs.csv hashes, equal end reasons and cap figures, runs_failed 0, every existing counter leaf identical; value_move.taken equals the sum of its leaves on every run.
